If you can't open the JSON file (e.g. you have a Chromebook or something), there are several ways to go about it.
One example is renaming the file extension from .json to .txt. They're both compatible, so it works.
Another example is using an online storage like Drive and copy + paste from there.
The simplest way would be to drag the file onto a new tab.
